notes.title: Update 15 - Item Drops! 0.5.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

You can now get item drops from playing Poppy Toast!

You can earn up to 3 a day simply by playing the game.

There are 6 tiers of quality:
- Common 65%
- Uncommon 20%
- Rare 10%
- Epic 3%
- Legendary 1.9%
- Mythic 0.1%

These items are sellable on the Steam Marketplace. 

Happy collecting!

tags.feature: You can now get item drops from playing Poppy Toast!
You can earn up to 3 a day simply by playing the game.
These items are sellable on the Steam Marketplace.
